short: An iron-hulled paddle steamer used by the East India Company during the First Opium War.
full:
Launched in 1839, the Nemesis was the first British ocean-going iron warship. Built for the Honourable East India Company, she featured a shallow draft and watertight bulkheads, alongside two powerful steam engines. She was secretly armed and dispatched to China, proving highly effective in riverine operations.

During the First Opium War, her manoeuvrability and heavy armament devastated Chinese junk fleets and coastal forts, demonstrating the overwhelming tactical advantage of steam-powered iron vessels in shallow waters. She continued to serve in anti-piracy operations in Asia until 1852, marking a definitive shift toward modern ironclad gunboat diplomacy.
